## Summary

The IEEE registry lists one MA-L block to Beijing Unigroup Tsingteng Microsystem Co., LTD. at a Haidian District, Beijing address [1]. The Chinese press names 紫光同芯 (Unigroup Tongxin, which the registrant's name appears to romanise) as a unit of Unigroup Guoxin (紫光国微) and reports that its THD89 secure chip was the first Chinese chip to pass SOGIS CC EAL6+ certification, aimed at finance, mobile communications, automotive electronics and identity authentication [2]. Unigroup Guoxin is itself a subsidiary of Tsinghua Unigroup [6]. The match between that Chinese name and the IEEE registrant is inferred, not stated by any source, so parent is left unknown.

The Common Criteria records list THD89 secure microcontroller certificates at EAL5+ under the Spanish scheme, one from 2018 now archived and a THD89 1.0.3 Secure Element certificate valid from September 2023 to September 2028; both name Tongxin Microelectronics Co., Ltd. as manufacturer [3][4]. TechInsights has floorplanned a Tsingteng Micro THN31FWC1 NFC controller taken from the 8849 TANK 3 smartphone [5].

Why a secure-element and NFC chip designer holds an OUI is not documented in the sources consulted; a MAC in this block could be a development board, a reference design or a product built on its chips, so device class is unknown. Founding year, FCC grantee codes and randomization are not listed: the company's own site returned no readable content and the FCC ID databases refused requests from the session that wrote this entry, and nothing is filled in from memory.
